_comment: How a case counts once its script may be marked flaky: a Failed result on a marked case is flaky, never failed; a mark changes nothing for any other result. Read by BOTH the Rust test (tests/suite/autorun_report.rs, autorun::report::is_flaky_failure) and the vitest one (tests/screens/AutoRun/verdicts.test.ts, isFlakyFailure), so the run report and the Auto Run screens can never count a flaky failure differently. Add a row here, and both sides are held to it.
